description.en:
Walker S is UBTECH's industrial humanoid for coordinated work on manufacturing lines. Its approximately 1.7-metre body combines force-feedback joints, whole-body manipulation and a perception system intended to support operation around production equipment and people.

The platform integrates U-SLAM and semantic navigation with task decision-making, hand-eye coordination and UBTECH's ROSA operating environment. Control options include graphical tools, teleoperation and connections to industrial systems. These components support development of inspection and handling workflows within existing factories. Actual capability depends on the deployed task, end effectors and line integration, rather than the robot's humanlike shape alone.
